items.title: Airbnb CEO: Our Specialized AI Agents Will Handle ‘Every Vertical in Travel’
items.snippet: Skift Take: There's been speculation for years about whether Airbnb would launch flights. Such small-minded speculation: Airbnb intends to use specialized AI agents to do every travel vertical. Airbnb Cruise, anyone? Airbnb CEO Brian Chesky said the company plans to develop specialized AI agents for integrations with numerous partners to handle bookings for "every vertical in travel" in the Airbnb app.

items.title: The Creative Upsells That Made Elements of Byron Over AUD 250,000
items.snippet: Elements of Byron implemented Canary Technologies across check-in, upsells, and checkout, generating over AUD 250,000 in upsell revenue with 75% of guests opting for mobile check-in.

items.title: Marriott focuses on AI, loyalty as tech enhances experiences
items.snippet: AI is changing how travelers discover travel options, while the Marriott Bonvoy loyalty program deepens the brand’s relationships with guests, CEO Anthony Capuano said. Marriott is putting AI and loyalty at the center of its technology-driven AI upgrades as it works to upgrade its experience without losing touch with its human side.

items.title: Airport Eats: Where to Eat and Drink at Portland International Airport
items.snippet: Portland International Airport’s $2.15 billion transformation brings travelers craft cocktails, wood-fired pizza, Oregon seafood and exceptional coffee, with local restaurants turning PDX into an unexpectedly delicious destination before departure.

items.title: We view tradition and innovation as complementary than opposing forces: Meerra Singh of Akhand Sweets
items.snippet: An Indian sweets (Mithai) brand established by three passionate young entrepreneurs, Delhi-based Akhand Sweets has tried to give traditional Indian Mithais a new flavour to make them stay relevant for the contemporary taste palates. According to Meerra Singh, one of the partners of the company, their endeavour from the very inception has been to create products that feel familiar yet relevant to new-age customers.

items.title: Sashtra Wellness targets three cities for expansion over next 5 years
items.snippet: Hyderabad-based Sashtra Wellness Pvt Ltd is targeting expansion across Hyderabad, Bengaluru and Visakhapatnam over the next five years, with plans to add partnerships with five-star hotels, golf clubs, premium residential communities and exclusive lifestyle institutions.

items.title: Eve & FlyBIS sign agreement for 12 eVTOLs
items.snippet: Eve Air Mobility and Brazilian operator FlyBIS have signed a binding agreement for up to 12 electric Vertical Take-Off and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft, marking a step towards establishing electric air mobility operations in Southern Brazil. The agreement includes two firm orders and purchase rights for ten additional aircraft, building on a Letter of Intent signed by the companies in 2022.

items.title: WTTC welcomes 50 new members across global tourism
items.snippet: The World Travel & Tourism Council (WTTC) has announced that 50 new members have joined the organisation so far in 2026, reflecting growing industry engagement across the global travel and tourism sector. The new members represent a broad range of businesses, including mobility, hospitality, travel retail, investment and insurance.

items.title: Summit Hotels & Resorts reports 162% growth in net operating profit in H1 FY 2026–27
items.snippet: In the first half of FY 2026–27, Summit Hotels & Resorts celebrated a remarkable 162 percent rise in net operating profit, significantly overshadowing its 14 percent revenue growth. The increase in average room rates by 26 percent reflects the company's adept revenue management.

items.title: Marriott International marks 800th property in Asia Pacific excluding China with debut in Laos
items.snippet: Marriott International has reached a significant milestone in its Asia Pacific excluding China (APEC) region with the opening of its 800th property, La Résidence Phou Vao, a Luxury Collection Resort & Spa, Luang Prabang. The opening also marks the company’s entry into Laos, expanding its presence in Southeast Asia.
